description: This file contains localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin for Bulgarian language support (version 4.0.6-rc.1). It defines translations for various user interface messages related to input validation, loading, and selection limits.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Provides a message indicating the user input is too long, specifying how many characters to remove.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Provides a message indicating the user needs to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Message displayed when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Message displayed when no matching results are found.
